news.headline: Wall Street settles on consensus Hold rating for Tenax Therapeutics after post-LEVEL analyst shakeout
news.summary: Aggregating the ten brokerages that cover the stock, MarketBeat reported an average Hold rating (1 Strong Buy, 3 Buy, 5 Hold, 1 Sell) and a consensus price target of $14.00, a figure still skewed by pre-LEVEL-miss targets that have not all been refreshed. The mixed spread underscores how unsettled sell-side opinion remains nearly a month after the trial's primary-endpoint failure.

news.headline: ADAR1 Capital Management and Daniel Schneeberger extend open-market buying spree in Tenax Therapeutics
news.summary: Funds managed by ADAR1 Capital Management, together with 10% owner Daniel Schneeberger, bought another 187,704 shares on September 2 at roughly $1.80, following purchases of 403,571 shares (Aug 31) and 179,058 shares (Sept 1) that lifted the group's stake to about 5.6 million shares. It remains the clearest bullish signal in the stock since the LEVEL primary-endpoint miss.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics announces CEO presentation at 2026 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference
news.summary: Tenax said President and CEO Chris Giordano would present at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on September 9, 2026 at 8:35 a.m. ET, with a live and archived webcast on the investor relations site. It was management's first scheduled public forum since the full LEVEL dataset was unveiled at ESC on August 29.

news.headline: Guggenheim downgrades Tenax Therapeutics to Neutral from Buy after reviewing full ESC LEVEL data
news.summary: Guggenheim moved off its Buy rating to Neutral with no price target, citing substantial clinical and regulatory uncertainty after digesting the complete LEVEL dataset presented at ESC. It had already slashed its price target to $4 from $40 right after the August 10 primary-endpoint miss while still rating the stock Buy, so this is a further step down.

news.headline: Full Phase 3 LEVEL data presented as a late-breaker at ESC Congress 2026 in Munich
news.summary: Professor Sanjiv Shah presented the complete LEVEL dataset: in the prespecified subgroup with baseline 6-minute walk distance below the trial median of 333m, levosimendan improved 6MWD by 26.3m versus placebo (p=0.0112), cut NT-proBNP by roughly 47-49% and improved right ventricular systolic pressure, with about 20 echocardiographic parameters improved across every domain measured. This subgroup and biomarker depth underpins Tenax's plan to pursue a narrower, enriched registrational path with the FDA and EMA.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Topline Results from Phase 3 LEVEL Clinical Trial of TNX-103 in Patients with PH-HFpEF
news.summary: The pivotal LEVEL trial missed its primary endpoint (6-minute walk distance, +3.5m vs placebo, p=0.63) and its key secondary endpoint (KCCQ), though prespecified subgroups of sicker patients showed a meaningful walk-distance benefit and strong biomarker/hemodynamic effects. Shares collapsed roughly 87-90% on the news, and Tenax said it would seek an FDA Type C meeting (and EMA scientific consultation) to discuss a revised registrational path using an enrichment strategy.

catalysts.label: CEO presentation at 2026 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference
catalysts.detail: President and CEO Chris Giordano is scheduled to present at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on Wednesday, September 9, 2026 at 8:35 a.m. ET, with a live and archived webcast available on the investor relations site. It is management's first scheduled public forum since the full LEVEL data went up at ESC on August 29, and investors will be listening for detail on the FDA Type C meeting strategy and the ongoing ADAR1/Schneeberger insider buying.

catalysts.label: FDA Type C meeting on levosimendan path forward
catalysts.detail: Tenax plans to request a Type C meeting with the FDA (and parallel EMA scientific consultation) to discuss an enrichment strategy for a revised registrational program, using the subgroup and biomarker data presented at ESC and the FDA's earlier agreement that a single well-controlled Phase 3 with p=0.01 could support an NDA. The outcome will determine whether LEVEL-2 is modified or a new study is required; no meeting date has been publicly confirmed yet.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings / cash runway and strategy update
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly report is estimated for November 18, 2026 (per third-party earnings calendars, not yet formally confirmed by the company) and should update the cash position (guided to a runway through Q2 2028 as of June 30, 2026) along with concrete next steps for the levosimendan program following the LEVEL trial failure, including any outcome from the planned FDA Type C meeting.

catalysts.label: LEVEL-2 Phase 3 enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: The global, roughly 540-patient LEVEL-2 registrational trial (2:1 randomization, over 100 sites across 15 countries) remains ongoing, with enrollment completion guided to end of 2027 as of the Q2 2026 update. Design and eligibility criteria may still be revised pending FDA feedback from the planned Type C meeting.

pulse: TENX has stabilized in the $1.80-1.90 range, near its post-LEVEL-miss lows, as the market digests the fuller August 29 ESC data showing a salvageable enriched subgroup - patients below the 333m baseline 6-minute-walk median saw a ~26m benefit (p=0.0112), a ~47-49% NT-proBNP reduction and roughly 20 improved echocardiographic parameters. Sell-side opinion stays split and cautious (Guggenheim cut to Neutral on August 31; MarketBeat's September 4 brokerage consensus landed at Hold with a stale-looking $14 average target), while the standout bullish signal remains insider buying, with ADAR1 Capital/Daniel Schneeberger funds accumulating roughly 770,000 shares (about $1.4 million) since August 31 alone and pushing their stake to about 5.6 million shares (~13-14%). With cash guided into Q2 2028, today's (September 9) CEO presentation at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference is the next scheduled event, ahead of the still-unscheduled FDA Type C meeting that will decide whether a narrower, enriched LEVEL-2 registrational path is viable.
